description: Cross-language UUID acceptance-domain oracle for the AAD builder (TS uuidToBytes via buildNodeAad / Rust build_node_aad). Locks canonical-only (Option A): both languages must accept exactly the canonical 8-4-4-12 hyphenated form and reject every other shape. AAD byte identity is already pinned separately by node-aad.json — this oracle covers the accept/reject DOMAIN only.

cases.description: simple 32-hex with no hyphens (TS currently over-accepts this)
loose-hyphen form: hyphens at non-canonical positions
loose-hyphen form: extra hyphen segments not at 8-4-4-4-12
braced form (Rust's uuid crate currently over-accepts this)
urn:uuid: prefixed form (Rust's uuid crate currently over-accepts this)
non-hex character in place of a hex digit
canonical UUID with a trailing newline (JS $ anchor also matches before a final \n; must still be rejected for Rust parity)
